# Official test assets (local only)

The official PDFs are **not committed**: they are large and may be
copyrighted. Keep them under `official_pdf/pdf/` (gitignored) and use the
checker to prove that the local copy matches the official test set.

## Four official test cases

| file | role | pages | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `1706.03762v1.pdf` | dedup v1 | 15 | 2,128,686 | `0a9bff1be3575cf9fe26a4a3d3a9175bc791ecec90de8b9deba4cff75d2b9476` |
| `1706.03762v7.pdf` | dedup v7 | 15 | 2,215,244 | `bdfaa68d8984f0dc02beaca527b76f207d99b666d31d1da728ee0728182df697` |
| `1706.03762v1_img.pdf` | OCR scan | 15 | 4,672,118 | `64094fe169dd4ff454f579e9f197298df1c118c24b71b1f1ca8bb218c9e4801d` |
| `UnderstandingDeepLearning_02_09_26_C.pdf` | long book | 541 | 22,344,992 | `f8237d393163900fa8e43210e680a3f987b45ccac7750b372e156fae3df0bf32` |

`official_pdf/pdf/` also contains 35 other papers (39 PDFs total, about
125.7MB) for the T-6.2a corpus and the multi-paper comparison. They are
local-only too.

`official_pdf/科研小助手Agent-AI大模型.pdf` (7 pages) is the competition
requirements document, not a test asset; ignore it.

## Commands

```powershell
# 1. Validate the four official assets (exits 1 on missing/mismatch)
uv run python scripts/check_official.py --dir official_pdf/pdf

# 2. Regenerate the committed manifest after a deliberate asset change
uv run python scripts/check_official.py --dir official_pdf/pdf --write-manifest

# 3. Asset-only acceptance (E2E still pending T-1.1/T-2.1)
uv run python scripts/accept_official.py --check-assets
```

`--inventory` prints every PDF with its page count and SHA256; use it when
you need the full corpus list.

## Caveats

- **Do not commit the PDFs.** `.gitignore` excludes `official_pdf/` and
  `tests/fixtures/official/*.pdf`. Only `README.md` and `manifest.json` are
  committed.
- **The 541-page book is 22.3MB**, above the current
  `RAG_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=20MB`. T-1.1 raises the limit to 64MB; until then the
  book upload is expected to fail with 413.
- `manifest.json` is generated by the checker; do not edit it by hand.
- `accept_official.py` currently implements asset validation only. The
  upload / duplicate-confirm / OCR / 541-page / multi-paper E2E steps belong
  to T-1.1 and T-2.1 and must fail loudly until implemented.
- If `1706.03762v1_img.pdf` is ever unavailable, substitute a **real**
  scanned paper and declare "非官方替代" in the document and video; do not
  pass a clean text-layer PDF as an OCR test.
